svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Device Claim - register, customer claim, reclaim and consistency boundaries

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Device Claim - register, customer claim, reclaim and consistency boundaries
MQTT reuses the authenticated connection SessionInfo.
Gateway resolves each connected virtual DeviceId.
The Actor does not await the ListenableFuture.
Registration failure cannot change the earlier device response
and normally cannot prevent the Core Queue commit.
[missing false wrong type or already assigned]
ClaimData stores plaintext secretKey and expirationTime.
putIfAbsent keeps the first unexpired or stale cache entry.
Attribute failure does not roll it back.
Customer REST does not pass through Device Actor.
There is no row lock, @Version, distributed lock, or
conditional UPDATE WHERE customer_id IS NULL.
Two customers may both return SUCCESS while last write wins.
The Device is already unassigned even though REST fails.
Claim and reclaim broadcast Device updates, but the 3.6 Transport
onDeviceUpdate merge does not rewrite SessionInfo customerId fields.
Long-lived MQTT or CoAP sessions can retain the old customer snapshot
until credentials are validated again or the device reconnects.
